Hi! I opened a PR #38275 adding AffineEquiv.image_intrinsicInterior with @Zichen Wang , generalizing AffineIsometry.image_intrinsicInterior.

Since affine equivalences are more general than affine isometries, the proof mainly relies on the fact that in finite-dimensional spaces, an affine equivalence induces a homeomorphism via AffineEquiv.toHomeomorphOfFiniteDimensional, so the assumptions are adjusted accordingly.

We have also recently formalized some results about intrinsic interior, so we expect to add more related results in follow-up PRs. Comments or suggestions would be very welcome.
